explication: DDNS Updater periodically discovers the host’s public IPv4/IPv6 addresses and updates configured DNS records across many providers. The principal workflow starts with configuration and provider settings, then fetches addresses, decides which records need changes, updates DNS, and persists status/history. The application also exposes a web UI and health endpoints, creates periodic data backups, and supports notifications and healthcheck reporting. The main entry point shows how services are assembled; unsampled provider implementations are represented by their existing directory.
